```c
/*******************************************************************************
* McStas instrument: t2_sans_collimation_optimized
*
* %D
* Optimized pinhole SANS instrument focusing on maximizing scattered intensity
* on the detector while maintaining beam divergence / pattern RMS width dX within
* the [4.539, 5.548] cm band.
*
* %P
* r_pin1: [m] Radius of the first source-defining pinhole
* r_pin2: [m] Radius of the second sample-defining pinhole
*
* %L
* <reference/literature>
*
* %E
*******************************************************************************/

DEFINE INSTRUMENT t2_sans_collimation_optimized(
    r_pin1 = 0.010,
    r_pin2 = 0.005
)

DECLARE
%{
%}

INITIALIZE
%{
%}

TRACE

COMPONENT Origin = Progress_bar()
  AT (0,0,0) ABSOLUTE

COMPONENT Source = Source_simple(
    radius = 0.02,
    dist = 3.0,
    focus_xw = 2.0 * r_pin1,
    focus_yh = 2.0 * r_pin1,
    lambda0 = 6.0,
    dlambda = 0.05
)
  AT (0,0,0) ABSOLUTE

COMPONENT Pin1 = Slit(
    radius = r_pin1
)
  AT (0,0,3.0) ABSOLUTE

COMPONENT Pin2 = Slit(
    radius = r_pin2
)
  AT (0,0,6.0) ABSOLUTE

COMPONENT Monitor_Pin2 = PSD_monitor(
    nx = 100, ny = 100,
    filename = "psd_pin2.dat",
    xwidth = 0.1, yheight = 0.1
)
  AT (0,0,6.001) ABSOLUTE
  ROTATED (0,0,0) ABSOLUTE
  SETTING (restore_neutron=1)

COMPONENT Sample = PowderN(
    unit_cell_volume = 125,
    d_spacing = 5.0,
    sigma_abs = 10,
    sigma_inc = 1,
    pack = 0.5,
    radius = 0.005,
    yheight = 0.01
)
  AT (0,0,9.0) ABSOLUTE

COMPONENT Beamstop = Beamstop(
    radius = 0.025,
    xwidth = 0.05,
    yheight = 0.05
)
  AT (0,0,11.999) ABSOLUTE

COMPONENT detector = PSD_monitor(
    nx = 120, ny = 120,
    filename = "detector.dat",
    xwidth = 0.6, yheight = 0.6
)
  AT (0,0,12.0) ABSOLUTE

END
```
